name: Plantex CSM+B Trace Mix
description: The classic chelated micronutrient mix for planted tanks. Published composition: 7.0% Fe (EDTA), 2.0% Mn, 1.5% Mg, 0.8% B, 0.4% Zn, 0.1% Cu, 0.06% Mo. A representative ~1.16 g in 40 US gal (~151 L) reaches ~0.5 ppm Fe.
notes: Iron is EDTA-chelated — availability drops above pH ~7. Copper content means caution in shrimp tanks; dose conservatively.
